bias.en: Recovery · above the 5-day, MACD back above zero
bias.zh: 复苏 · 站上 5 日均线，MACD 回到零轴上方

read.en: Broadcom rose 3.6% on Nov 18 to $354.05, trading $340.74–357.34. It is above the 5-day ($348.1) and 10-day ($332.2), both rising, and the 30-day ($336.7, falling), and below the 100-day ($363.9) and 200-day ($367.7). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11 and moved just above zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($302.97), and RSI is 55.1.
read.zh: 博通 11月18日上涨 3.6%，收于 $354.05，盘中区间 $340.74–357.34。股价位于 5 日（$348.1）和 10 日均线（$332.2，二者均上行）以及 30 日均线（$336.7，下行）上方，低于 100 日（$363.9）和 200 日均线（$367.7）。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，并刚升至零轴上方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$302.97），RSI 为 55.1。

read.en: The close reclaimed the 5-day and the $344.3–347 resistance, now support, and closed at the $350–356.9 zone. Resistance is $356.9–358.5 (Nov 11, 18 and 13 highs), then $363.9–369.8 (100 and 200-day, Nov 12 high) and $376.6–380.8. Support is $344.3–348.1, then $336.7–340.7 (30-day, Nov 13 and 18 lows) and $332. A close above $358.5 would target $364–370; below $344.3, $337–341.

r.en: Nov 11 high $356.85; Nov 18 high $357.34; Nov 13 high $358.47

s.en: Nov 11 low $344.31; Nov 13 close $347.01; 5-day average $348.1, reclaimed
